record.experiment_description:
Objectives:

Previous research has indicated that a critical period of weight bearing may exist for the development of the motor system in animals. If this is the case, there are striking implications for raising normal animals, including humans, in the microgravity environment of space. This experiment tested the hypothesis that gravity-associated weight bearing is required postnatally for normal neuromuscular development of motor neurons, neuromuscular junctions, and muscle fiber types of the antigravity soleus muscle, but not for that of the extensor digitorum longus (EDL), a nonweightbearing muscle.

Approach:

Rat pups, eight days old at launch, were exposed to microgravity during 16 days of their development. Because of high inflight mortality among the pups, specific studies of the development of soleus and EDL motor neurons and assessment of long-term recovery changes in the neuromuscular system could not be fully completed. The study focused on fiber-type differentiation and neuromuscular junction development. Muscle and spinal cord tissues of Neurolab rats were processed and analyzed to evaluate muscle fiber type differentiation, cytoplasm/nucleus ratios, neuromuscular junction development, and spinal motor properties. A ground-control simulation, consisting of a group of hindlimb-suspended pups with a schedule of four hours unloaded and two hours returned to the dam for nursing, was repeated 24 hours a day for nine days. Litter mates of the hindlimb-suspension control were removed from the dam on the same schedule as the unloaded rats and singly housed to provide isolation controls. The data from the ground controls were used to distinguish unloading effects from isolation effects on neuromuscular system development.

Results:

Exposure to space flight resulted in microgravity-induced unloading as well as reduced neonate-dam and neonate-neonate interactions. The inflight retardation of neonate body weight gain was recovered one month postflight. Fewer large soleus fibers postflight suggested stunted growth for some fibers. Higher cytoplasm/nuclear ratios indicated a persistent deficit in soleus myoblast function. Differentiation from embryonic to slow fiber type was transiently retarded and enhanced toward fast type. Space flight temporarily increased the susceptibility of developing soleus fibers to reloading damage. Elimination of multiple innervation was completed during space flight. The pattern of terminal branching of motor nerve endings was less complex, implying delayed maturation. Space flight retarded the growth of spinal motor neurons. Down-regulation of mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase activity and gene expression in lumbar spinal motor neurons indicated lower oxidative capacity in the flight rats. Lower levels of choline acetyltransferase and Cat-301 proteoglycan indicated delayed motor neuron maturation, regarding neurotransmitter synthesis and extracellular matrix organization. Overall, the results from the neonates emphasize the importance of weight bearing exercise for the normal development of the infant neuromuscular system.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Inflight Dam/Litter Food Consumption, Mammalian Development P7 Sim-Caged Group
dataset_description: This file presents daily inflight food consumption data for the Mammalian Development P7 group dams/litters, broken down by dam number.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Preflight/Inflight Dam/Litter Water Consumption, Mammalian Development P7 Sim-Caged Group
dataset_description: This file presents daily preflight (4/10/98 - 4/22/98) and inflight (4/23/98 - 5/11/98) water consumption data for the Mammalian Development P7 group sim-caged dams/litters, broken down by dam number (8 day delayed control). Data is also presented graphically. Water consumption is measured in milliliters.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Inflight Dam/Litter Food Consumption, Mammalian Development P7 Flight Group
dataset_description: This file presents daily inflight food consumption data for the Mammalian Development P7 flight group dams/litters, broken down by dam number.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Postflight Food and Water Consumption Data for Mammalian Development P7 Vivarium-Caged Group
dataset_description: Postflight food and water consumption data for mammalian development P7 vivarium-caged group (4 day delayed control: data for animals not dissected ‘postflight’). Animals are tracked from 5/8/98 through dissections ending 6/11/98. File tracks neonate renumbering postflight.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Preflight Delta Weight, Preflight/Inflight Food and Water Consumption Data for Mammalian Development P7 Vivarium-Caged Group
dataset_description: This file contains pre- and inflight data for the Mammalian Development P7 vivarium-caged group (4 day delayed control). Preflight dam body weight and litter weight (post-birthing on 4/12/98 - 4/13/98) is tracked from 4/5/98 to cage load on 4/18/98, and also collected at cage unload. Preflight food and water consumption is tracked per dam/dam + litter through cage load. Inflight food and water consumption is tracked from cage load to FD17. Cage unload dam weights, litter weights, and total food and water consumption is also recorded.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Preflight/Inflight Dam/Litter Water Consumption, Mammalian Development P7 Vivarium-Caged Group
dataset_description: This file presents daily preflight (4/6/98 - 4/18/98) and inflight (4/19/98 - 5/7/98) water consumption data for the Mammalian Development P7 group vivarium-caged dams/litters, broken down by dam number (4 day delayed control). Data is also presented graphically. Water consumption is measured in grams.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Inflight Dam/Litter Water Consumption, Mammalian Development P7 Flight Group
dataset_description: This file presents daily inflight water consumption data for the Mammalian Development P7 flight group dams/litters, broken down by dam. Data is also presented graphically. Water consumption is measured in milliliters (not labeled on the chart).

dataset_info.dataset_name: Inflight Dam/Litter Food Consumption, Mammalian Development P7 Vivarium-Caged Group
dataset_description: This file presents daily inflight food consumption data for the Mammalian Development P7 vivarium group dams/litters, broken down by dam number.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Cross-Group (Flight, Sim-Caged, Vivarium) Comparison of Inflight Dam/Litter Food Consumption, Mammalian Development P7 Group
dataset_description: This file presents a cross-group comparison of all Flight, Sim-Caged and Vivarium dam/litter inflight food consumption for the Mammalian Development P7 group. Summary data is presented both in tabular and graphic formats.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Cross-Group (Flight, Sim-Caged, Vivarium) Comparison of Inflight Dam/Litter Water Consumption, Mammalian Development P7 Group
dataset_description: This file presents a cross-group comparison of all Flight, Sim-Caged and Vivarium dam/litter inflight water consumption for the Mammalian Development P7 group. Summary data is presented both in tabular and graphic formats.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Preflight (at Cage Load) Animal Weights, Mammalian Development P7 Sim-Caged Group
dataset_description: This file contains preflight (collected at cage load) Animal ID, Body Weight, and RAHF Cage Slot/ID data for the 12 Mammalian Development P7 Sim-Caged Dams and Litters (individual neonate weights included). (8 day delayed control)

dataset_info.dataset_name: Preflight Delta Weight, Preflight/Inflight Food and Water Consumption Data for Mammalian Development P7 Sim-Caged Group
dataset_description: This file contains pre- and inflight data for the Mammalian Development P7 Sim-caged animal pool (8 day delayed control). Preflight dam body weight and litter weight (post-birthing on 4/16/98 - 4/17/98) is tracked from 4/9/98 to cage load on 4/22/98, and also collected at cage unload. Preflight food and water consumption is tracked per dam/dam + litter through cage load. Inflight food and water consumption from the feeder tape pulls and lixit counts is tracked from cage load to FD17. Cage unload dam weights, litter weights, and total food and water consumption is also recorded.

dataset_info.dataset_name: Litter Equalization Operations, Mammalian Development P7 Flight Group

dataset_info.dataset_name: Litter Selection, Mammalian Development P7 Flight Group
dataset_description: This spreadsheet contains data used to select the final two flight dams and litters from the flight animal pool. Dams/litters 3102, 3109, 3114, 3119, 3120, 3124, 3131, 3134, 3135, 3140, 3142, and 3143 were selected for flight.
